% Generated by tools/design/identity.py from styles/templates/ and design/identity configuration.
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\usepackage{fvextra}
\usepackage{geometry}
% Width and height are bounding limits, never independent stretch dimensions.
\setkeys{Gin}{keepaspectratio=true}
\KOMAoptions{fontsize=11pt,twoside=true,open=any,numbers=noendperiod}
\geometry{paperwidth=210mm,paperheight=297mm,inner=26mm,outer=24mm,top=22mm,bottom=23mm,headheight=25pt,headsep=5mm,footskip=10mm}
\usepackage[automark,headsepline]{scrlayer-scrpage}
\definecolor{BookInk}{HTML}{182B3A}
\definecolor{BookNight}{HTML}{101F30}
\definecolor{BookLink}{HTML}{126178}
\definecolor{BookAmber}{HTML}{F5B544}
\setmainfont{DejaVu Serif}
\setsansfont{DejaVu Sans}
\setmonofont[Scale=0.85]{DejaVu Sans Mono}
\setkomafont{disposition}{\sffamily\bfseries\color{BookNight}}
\setkomafont{caption}{\sffamily\small}
\setkomafont{captionlabel}{\sffamily\small\bfseries}
\setkomafont{pageheadfoot}{\normalfont\sffamily\footnotesize}
\clearpairofpagestyles
\automark[section]{chapter}
\ihead{\parbox[b]{.86\textwidth}{\raggedright\headmark}}
\ohead{\pagemark}
\cfoot[\pagemark]{}
\renewcommand*{\chapterpagestyle}{plain.scrheadings}
% Preserve long commands and report rows rather than clipping them at the page edge.
\DefineVerbatimEnvironment{Highlighting}{Verbatim}{commandchars=\\\{\},breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,breaknonspaceingroup=true,breaksymbolleft=\tiny\ensuremath{\hookrightarrow}}
\RecustomVerbatimEnvironment{verbatim}{Verbatim}{breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,breaksymbolleft=\tiny\ensuremath{\hookrightarrow}}
% Hierarchy, navigation, and content furniture belong to this layer.
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=2em,afterskip=1.25em]{chapter}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=1.4em,afterskip=.65em]{section}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=1.1em,afterskip=.45em]{subsection}
\RedeclareSectionCommands[tocdynnumwidth=true,tocnumsep=.6em]{chapter,section,subsection,subsubsection}
\RedeclareSectionCommands[tocdynindent=true]{section,subsection,subsubsection}
% Captions remain separate text, with original figure proportions preserved.
\usepackage{caption}
\captionsetup{font=small,labelfont={bf,sf},textfont=sf,justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false,skip=7pt}
\captionsetup[figure]{position=bottom}
\captionsetup[table]{position=top}
% Pandoc supplies booktabs rules, wrapped columns and repeated longtable heads.
\AtBeginEnvironment{longtable}{\small\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.12}}
\setlength{\LTpre}{.8\baselineskip}
\setlength{\LTpost}{.8\baselineskip}
% Footnotes remain readable and may continue rather than forcing large blanks.
\setkomafont{footnote}{\normalfont\footnotesize}
\addtolength{\skip\footins}{4pt}
\interfootnotelinepenalty=1000

% Quarto creates semantic, breakable callouts; restyle them after its definitions.
% Text labels/icons remain meaningful when the accent colors are printed gray.
\AtBeginDocument{%

  \definecolor{quarto-callout-warning-color}{HTML}{8B4C12}%

  \definecolor{quarto-callout-important-color}{HTML}{963F3F}%
  \colorlet{quarto-callout-note-color-frame}{quarto-callout-note-color}%
  \colorlet{quarto-callout-tip-color-frame}{quarto-callout-tip-color}%
  \colorlet{quarto-callout-warning-color-frame}{quarto-callout-warning-color}%
  \colorlet{quarto-callout-caution-color-frame}{quarto-callout-caution-color}%
